The camera is just below her eye level, a natural 50mm photographic perspective; moderate depth of field keeps the important pipe-to-spirit-to-lamp relation legible. Blue-white magical light, amber gaslight and deep wet burgundy form a restrained palette. Tactile wool, oxidized brass, damp stone and softly imperfect skin; grounded photographic textures, practical shadow and coherent reflections. The ordinary city has accepted this small supernatural maintenance task as part of its night work.
